parameters.help: Generate a free key (100 req/day) at https://www.freightutils.com/api-docs. Upgrade to Pro (50,000 req/month, £19) at https://www.freightutils.com/pricing.

error.message: [{{statusCode}}] Invalid API key. Check the value or generate a new one at https://www.freightutils.com/api-docs.

_comment_api: Connection validation MUST use an ABSOLUTE url: Make connections do not inherit base.baseUrl (that applies to modules only) — the original relative '/health' made every connection attempt fail with 'Invalid URL' before the request even left Make (found by the first live dogfood, 2026-08-22). /api/auth/whoami is the house-standard auth test (Zapier + n8n use it too): 200 {authenticated, tier, key_prefix} on a valid key, 401 on a bad one — /api/health would fake-green any key. uid=key_prefix is server-derived and non-PII.
